messages:
alice: Heads-up — pushing the canary for release/2024-06/edge-routing in the 20m change window. Please review backout plan and pin steps. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-safety (see section 'canary-failures')
devon: ack. I checked release notes, nothing risky in schema changes. canary targets: 5 hosts eu-west, 3 hosts us-east.
lee: +1. I left a note in the PR about the DB toggle. ops team: are we good with the quick-unpin path?
sam: quick-unpin path is in the runbook. TL;DR: deploybot unpin -> traffic rollback -> cache flush -> monitor 10m. Command to unpin: `deploybot pin remove release/2024-06/edge-routing --reason "canary-fail"`
alice: thanks. tagging @deploybot for preflight checks. also, add the emergency rollback checklist to the changelog entry (so oncall knows where to look).
deploybot: Preflight OK: CI passed, canary images built, health-checks green. Canary scheduled at 1718205600. Notifying canary-owners channel. :rocket:
maya: quick note: QA will be watching 3 endpoints (route, reroute, eviction). If we see 5% error rate sustained for 3m we hold.
lee: noted. i'll be by the console for the canary start. if hold -> we'll run the backout sequence from runbook step 4.1.
alice: canary started now. traffic 2% -> 10% ramp over 15m. logs: `kubectl logs -l app=edge-routing -n canary` for quick tail.
sam: seeing increased 502s on eu-west-2. stack traces point to session store timeout. investigating.
maya: also seeing latency spike on reroute endpoint in EU. currently 450ms p95 -> 1.6s.
devon: hold? we should halt the ramp at 10% and remove pin if it continues climbing.
lee: i vote hold and unpin proactively to limit blast radius.
alice: hold ramp. i'm executing the graceful degrade path: set feature-flag edge-routing.v2 -> off, then run unpin if no recovery in 3m.
deploybot: Canary ramp paused at 10%. Flag toggle executed by alice. Monitoring 180s window.
sam: after flag toggle latencies improved slightly but errors still ~3.8%. not back to baseline. recommend unpin.
ale: (typo) -- meant alice continued: unpin now. executing `deploybot pin remove release/2024-06/edge-routing --reason "canary-errs"`
deploybot: Unpin accepted. Rolling traffic back to pinned release/2024-05. Rolling updates in progress: eu-west first. Expected completion ~5m.
maya: flushing edge cache on eu-west nodes: `redis-cli -h cache-eu-1 FLUSHALL` (done).
sam: watching logs. errors dropping to 0.8% and p95 back to ~480ms.
devon: good call. let's file a postmortem note in the release thread and include the steps we took + metrics. also add a follow-up to evaluate session store timeout tuning.
ale: (alice) i'll add follow-ups. sequence summary for release notes: 1) canary ramp halted at 10% 2) feature flag toggled 3) unpin and rollback to 2024-05 4) cache flush 5) monitoring and gradual re-evaluate.
lee: adding runbook pointers in the release PR: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/deploy-safety#canary-failures and the emergency rollback checklist: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/emergency-rollback
deploybot: Canary rollback complete across canary hosts. Notifying release-coordinator and oncall. :white_check_mark:
devon: nice work team. when we reattempt, propose we stagger EU host upgrades and increase session store timeout by 50% in the candidate image.
maya: ack. i'll coordinate with infra to get a canary image with the timeout tweak.
alice: closing this canary thread. will reopen when we have a new candidate. thanks everyone. :heart:
